campaigns.concept: Al-Mg-Sc-Zr / Al-Ti-family additive-manufacturing metallurgy and programmable deposited zoning
supported_foundation: Sc/Zr microalloying and Al3(Sc,Zr) precipitation strengthening are established in additively manufactured aluminum alloys.
DED and LPBF can produce materially different microstructures and strengthening behavior.
Titanium can contribute grain-refinement/nucleation effects in aluminum alloy processing.
not_yet_supported: repeatable programmed property zoning in the Worldshepherd process
aerospace qualification, fatigue life, corrosion performance, or production economics

external_evidence.title: AlMgScZr alloys for laser powder bed fusion additive manufacturing. A review
Microstructural evolution and strengthening mechanisms of additively-manufactured Al-Mg-Sc-Zr alloys: Laser directed energy deposition versus laser powder bed fusion
Synthesis of precipitation-strengthened Al-Sc, Al-Zr and Al-Sc-Zr alloys via selective laser melting of elemental powder blends

next_experiments: freeze composition/process-window hypotheses before manufacturing
manufacture baseline and candidate coupons with full powder/wire and process provenance
measure chemistry and zoning by appropriate compositional mapping
characterize porosity, grain structure, precipitates, and phase content
perform hardness and tensile testing in multiple orientations
repeat across independently manufactured coupons
compare measured properties with preregistered baseline and simulation predictions

campaigns.concept: Reconfigurable electromagnetic boundary conditions using phase, amplitude, and material-state control
supported_foundation: Active metasurfaces can dynamically manipulate scattered electromagnetic wavefronts by controlling phase and amplitude across subwavelength elements.
Reconfigurable metasurfaces have experimentally demonstrated beam steering and other wavefront-control functions.
Electrical, phase-change, mechanical, thermal, and other tuning mechanisms are established research approaches.
not_yet_supported: broadband 195 nm to 9675 nm control by one architecture
field-control performance under aerospace thermal, vibration, and EMC environments

external_evidence.title: Electrically tunable space-time metasurfaces at optical frequencies

next_experiments: select one bounded operating band and unit-cell architecture
simulate S-parameters, phase range, loss, mutual coupling, and thermal sensitivity
fabricate a small coupon/array
measure S-parameters with calibrated instrumentation
measure phase/amplitude control versus command state
demonstrate beam steering or null placement against a preregistered target
repeat after thermal cycling and orientation changes

campaigns.concept: Electrostatic acceleration of ions for spacecraft propulsion
supported_foundation: Ion propulsion is a flight-proven spacecraft propulsion method.
Known ion-thruster physics links propellant mass flow, accelerating voltage, beam current, thrust, specific impulse, efficiency, and lifetime.
not_yet_supported: Worldshepherd-specific thruster thrust, efficiency, lifetime, plume behavior, or flight readiness

external_evidence.title: 4.0 In-Space Propulsion
external_evidence.organization: NASA Small Spacecraft Systems Virtual Institute

next_experiments: define propellant, grid geometry, voltage/current envelope, neutralization scheme, and thermal limits
perform vacuum electrical checkout
measure thrust on a calibrated thrust stand
close mass-flow and electrical-power budgets
measure plume current/energy and spacecraft-charging implications
run endurance testing before any lifetime claim

campaigns.concept: Resonant electromagnetic cavities or field configurations investigated for anomalous net force
supported_foundation: Electromagnetic resonance, radiation pressure, thermal expansion, magnetic coupling, and conventional momentum transfer are established physics.
High-accuracy published testing of EMDrive-type cavities found no anomalous thrust above the photon-thrust limit under improved controls.
not_yet_supported: closed-cavity thrust exceeding radiation-pressure limits without an external momentum channel
electrogravitic or gravity-control interpretation of an electromagnetic force signal

external_evidence.title: High-accuracy thrust measurements of the EMDrive and elimination of false-positive effects

next_experiments: preregister the predicted force scaling, sign, frequency dependence, and falsification condition
establish photon-thrust baseline Fc/P
use calibrated force instrumentation with sensitivity below the claimed residual
separate thermal, magnetic, cable, electrostatic, vibration, outgassing, and gas-flow effects
perform resonance/off-resonance and dummy-load controls
repeat in vacuum when atmosphere-dependent forces are plausible
require independent replication before any beyond-standard-model interpretation

campaigns.concept: Directed electromagnetic power transfer / power beaming
next_experiments: freeze transmitter, frequency, aperture, receiver, distance, and safety assumptions
validate link budget and thermal model
perform low-power calibrated range test
measure end-to-end efficiency, pointing error, sidelobes, and thermal response
scale only after safety and EMC review

campaigns.concept: Radar/electromagnetic sensing and inference under complex scattering
next_experiments: separate synthetic-data performance from measured-data performance
define radar equation and propagation assumptions
collect calibrated target/background datasets
measure detection and identification performance separately
test across geometry, weather, clutter, and sensor perturbations

campaigns.concept: Integrated aerospace vehicle, controls, autonomy, energy, and propulsion architecture
next_experiments: freeze mass, power, thermal, structural, propulsion, and control budgets
validate each subsystem independently
run hardware-in-the-loop control and lost-link testing
perform structural/vibration and EMC tests
progress from tethered/ground tests to bounded flight tests only after safety review
verify dose-engine mathematics against accepted reference cases
establish dataset governance and de-identification
propagate uncertainty through optimization
run retrospective comparison against accepted baselines
obtain qualified medical-physics review before clinical claims
